response.sql: SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE e.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND e.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: Each execution row is counted once, so an order with several executions contributes one count per execution. The inner joins drop executions whose order or user does not exist.
Users with a NULL acctscope form their own group, which appears as a NULL acctscope row in the result. The request does not say whether to keep or drop them.
